name: setu
description: Setu (সেতু) — AI SME Finance Copilot (simulated sandbox)

scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: uv run --directory backend python -m seed.cli seed
scripts.db:reset-demo: uv run --directory backend python -m seed.cli reset-demo
scripts.kb:sync: uv run --directory backend python -m app.rag.cli sync
scripts.kb:index: uv run --directory backend python -m app.rag.cli index
scripts.dev:agent: uv run --directory backend fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir frontend i18n:check && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && uv run --directory backend ruff check . ../rag_agent && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . ../rag_agent
scripts.format: pnpm --dir frontend format && uv run --directory backend ruff format . ../rag_agent && uv run --directory backend ruff check --fix . ../rag_agent
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest -q && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.demo:run: uv run --directory backend python -m app.demo.cli run
scripts.demo:check: uv run --directory backend python -m app.demo.cli check
scripts.demo:record: uv run --directory backend python -m app.demo.cli record
scripts.demo:cleanup: uv run --directory backend python -m app.demo.cli cleanup
scripts.demo:verify: uv run --directory backend python -m app.demo.cli verify
